components.text: The Rover is a [color=yellow]drivable vehicle[color] built for exploring the surface of other planets.
Place it down, hop in and drive across hostile terrain in comfort. [br] [br]

The rover can be customized with modules : [br] - [color=cyan]Cargo[color] module adds inventory slots. [br] - [color=cyan]Tank[color] module stores fluid for the trip. [br] - [color=cyan]Speed[color] module makes the rover faster. [br] - [color=cyan]Hydrogen Motor[color] powers the rover with hydrogen fuel.
